purpose: Teach: 実戦/石綿/快晴/歳児/ミドル/水上/境内/パース

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、武道の実戦稽古の歴史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on the history of martial arts practice, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, genuinely curious. Open invitation to share. Steady gaze that says she's actually listening. No rush.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、石綿アスベスト被害の医学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote mine on the medical impacts of asbestos exposure.
lines.style: Clear and direct. Slight surprise at the mismatch — she's checking if she answered the right question. Respectful but not self-diminishing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 快晴日数の気象研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You chose weather research on clear-sky frequencies for your topic, then?
lines.style: Gentle curiosity, almost thinking aloud. Pause before the question — she's processing what she heard. Warm but careful not to assume.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、三歳児健診の発達評価を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about developmental assessment in three-year health check-ups.
lines.style: Patient correction. Not unkind. She's answering what was actually asked this time. Slight lift of confidence at the mismatch.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ミドルクラスの社会学を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you addressed middle-class sociology in your paper, is that right?
lines.style: Engaged leaning-in. She's testing whether she heard correctly. Respectful check-in. Interest is genuine.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、水上スポーツの安全研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about water safety in aquatic sports.
lines.style: Calm certainty. She's anticipating the pattern now. Direct eye contact. Almost gentle confirmation of the recurring theme.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 神社境内の伝統儀礼を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: So shrine rituals and traditional ceremonies were what you explored?
lines.style: Reflective, almost musing. Gently checking one more time. The tone of someone who knows the pattern but wants to hear it confirmed.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、コンピューターのパース処理を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about parser processing in computer science.
lines.style: Quiet finality. She's understood the rhythm now. No hesitation. Small satisfied breath — the exchange is complete.
